'''2020 TMW Pods Martin den Boef DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Martin den Boef]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Player:''' [[Martin den Boef]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Legal Boef DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
